title: Atlas story node: character
description: One entry of content/story/characters.json — a NARRATIVE character node in the story graph. Deliberately named story-character.schema.json (not character.schema.json) to avoid colliding with the pre-existing content/schemas/character.schema.json, which validates the F-005 markdown character-SHEET frontmatter (content/characters/*.md) — a different document with a different shape. See docs/superpowers/specs/2026-07-22-epic-story-pipeline-design.md.
